reason: B is more specific and falsifiable, with grain size controlled and explicit measurements linking chemical short-range order, SFE, slip/twinning, and strain hardening. Its assumed ordering of SFE and ductility is questionable—CrCoNi-type ternaries can have lower SFE and stronger twinning than the Cantor alloy—but A relies even more directly on the unsupported premise that fewer constituents necessarily mean less lattice distortion and lower ductility.
